message:
Connect independent chat inputs and processing recipients (#159)

* fix: preserve saved account mode and repair CI fixtures

* fix: preserve resolved context target across foreground reload [skip ci]

Capture the active endpoint instead of reselecting a named or ambient context on reexec. Preserve argument values, saved-session entry points, cwd and environment. Add focused argument and actual local reload regressions, and document named context selection.

* fix(ci): align Session service isolated runtime setup

* test: expose protocol fixture startup failures

* fix: accept an argument slice in context normalization [skip ci]

Resolve the ptr_arg warning found by the fixed-candidate local Clippy gate. The normalization body and argument behavior are unchanged.

* feat: define independent chat input and recipient settings

* feat: connect chat input adapters to configured recipients

* docs: explain chat input and recipient modes

* fix: preserve chat routing, history and saved-session admission

* fix: address strict Clippy in merged chat and socket code

* feat: disable human chat per client with input none

* feat: show countdown, elapsed and observation time explicitly

* test: fix Linux socket and steering fixture configuration

* fix: keep reload independent of disabled chat

* fix: restore agent header clicks and align CI fixtures

* fix: include existing local mode files in the source package

* perf: batch terminal paste and completion work

* test: expect the explicit Next caller recipient [skip ci]

* release: prepare 0.10.24 source metadata [skip ci]

* test(computer): cover inherited input lease descriptor lifetime [skip ci]

* fix: confirm pre-query native directory misses once [skip ci]
